correctness.rationale: The grounded trace equals the sum of two-ground resistances; the exact three-terminal star identity and vertex transitivity give J=2Na-NR/4-2(b-c)/R. Fourier characters provide R=2A/(Nq) and b-c=B/(Nq²), and a strictly decreasing density ratio proves both A and B/A strictly increase with distance. All quantifiers and domain boundaries are explicit; 147 strict rational inequalities, 18 direct grounded inversions, and 7 counts were replayed from the included real checker; finite samples are not used as a universal proof.
